Quad.OnCommand: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_1) and GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_1) then self:hidden(0) self:x(SCREEN_LEFT+30) self:y(SCREEN_TOP+47) self:horizalign('left') self:diffuse(0,0,0,1) self:zoomtowidth(175) self:zoomtoheight(18) else self:hidden(1) end end

%function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsPlayerEnabled(PLAYER_2) and GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_2) then self:hidden(0) self:x(SCREEN_RIGHT-30) self:y(SCREEN_TOP+47) self:horizalign('right') self:diffuse(0,0,0,1) self:zoomtowidth(175) self:zoomtoheight(18) else self:hidden(1) end end

ActorFrame.OnCommand: %function(self) self:stopeffect() if FUCK_EXE then stitch('lua.death').Start() end end
